title: npm audit disabled in the client configuration
description: .npmrc declares a client setting that turns the install-time audit off. Advisory findings for the installed tree are never requested, so a vulnerable transitive package installs without any signal reaching the build log.
remediation: Leave auditing enabled, or run the audit as a separate CI step that fails the build.
limitation: It matches a client setting that turns the install-time audit off in the parsed .npmrc; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
